headline: ABS-CBN to Cut Around 200 Jobs as Advertising Pressure Weighs on Recovery
seoTitle: ABS-CBN to Cut Around 200 Jobs as Ad Pressure Persists | FMB News
seoDescription: ABS-CBN says a retrenchment program will affect around 200 people, about 7% of its workforce, as weak advertising and consumer spending pressure its recovery.
deck: The media company says around 200 people, or roughly 7% of its workforce, will be affected as weak advertising and consumer spending continue to weigh on its recovery.
author: FMB News Business Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: ABS-CBN Corporation announced a retrenchment program covering around 200 people, equivalent to roughly 7% of its workforce, as the company seeks to keep its finances on stronger footing.

In its statement, as reported by GMA News and Philstar, ABS-CBN cited geopolitical conflict, high inflation and slow economic growth as pressures that have weakened advertising demand and consumer spending across the content industry.
Philstar reported that ABS-CBN posted a first-half net loss of P1.83 billion, more than double the P852 million loss recorded a year earlier, even as operating expenses declined.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: ABS-CBN has been rebuilding its business around content production and distribution across television partnerships, digital platforms, film, music and live events after losing its broadcast franchise in 2020.
The latest retrenchment follows a smaller workforce reduction in 2024 and comes while the company continues to pursue new capital and ownership arrangements intended to support its recovery.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The cuts directly affect media workers and also illustrate the financial pressure facing legacy content businesses as advertising budgets fragment across television, digital platforms and creator-led media.

For the Philippine media sector, the issue is not only the health of one company. Continued restructuring at a major content producer can affect employment, production capacity, supplier ecosystems and the range of locally produced programming.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch how ABS-CBN implements the retrenchment, whether advertising conditions improve, and whether new investments translate into a more sustainable operating model.
Future earnings reports will show whether lower costs and the company’s shift toward multi-platform content distribution are enough to narrow losses.
